value.rationale: The projective toric variety of the canonical rank-three Fano matroid is a distinguished object. Its 70 maximal singular orbit closures split into genuinely different geometric dimensions and combinatorial types; every generic transverse class group is Z and all simplicial normal cones turn out unimodular. This is a substantive complete classification rather than a routine isolated numerical invariant.
